commit.message: docs(dcp): formalize dopemux init registry contract
verify: rg -n "\.dopemux|dopemux.toml|workspace|init" README.md PROJECT.md ARCHITECTURE.md AGENTS.md docs/03-reference -S || true

invariants: Marker contract must be OBSERVED or UNKNOWN.
OUT OF SCOPE: No changes to dopemux init behavior.
OUT OF SCOPE: No facade implementation.
OUT OF SCOPE: No auto-registering projects.
OUT OF SCOPE: No writes to .dopemux metadata.
OUT OF SCOPE: No service startup.
STOP IF: No init/workspace identity code can be found.
STOP IF: Multiple conflicting marker contracts require supervisor decision.
STOP IF: Any validation would require mutating a workspace.
STOP IF: Generated docs would need to reveal local secrets or private paths.
FORBIDDEN FILE: src/** except read-only inspection

pr.body:
Inspect actual dopemux init/workspace identity behavior and formalize the project registry validation contract without implementing the facade.

Required PR sections: Objective, Scope, Evidence, Validation, Embedded audit, Risks and unknowns, Rollback, Proof bundle links
pr.title: Dopemux init registry discovery for readonly MCP facade

requirements: Static inspection of dopemux init, workspace validation, project/workspace config, and .dopemux marker usage.
Document observed init markers and unknowns.
steps.task: Implement per objective: Inspect actual dopemux init/workspace identity behavior and formalize the project registry validation contract without implementing the facade. In-scope work: Static inspection of dopemux init, workspace validation, project/workspace config, and .dopemux marker usage. Document observed init markers and unknowns. Refine MULTI_PROJECT_REGISTRY_CONTRACT.md based on evidence. Add DOPMUX_INIT_REGISTRY_DISCOVERY.md.
validation: No files outside commit.allowlist are modified; change matches the stated scope.

commands: rg -n "dopemux init|def init|@.*init|workspace_id|workspace_root|repo_root|\.dopemux|project_id|repo_marker|validate.*workspace|resolve.*workspace|projects list|list_projects|registry" src services docs tests pyproject.toml
rg -n "\.dopemux|dopemux.toml|workspace|init" README.md PROJECT.md ARCHITECTURE.md AGENTS.md docs/03-reference -S || true
steps.task: Run the packet validation commands and inspect the diff.
validation: Observed init markers are documented with exact paths and code references, or marked UNKNOWN.
Registry contract no longer depends on invented marker assumptions.
Multi-project resolver algorithm is explicit and fail-closed.

requirements: AUDIT.md challenging init marker findings and project registry assumptions.
steps.task: Produce the proof bundle under proof/TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0003/ (PROOF.json, COMMAND_LOG.md, AUDIT.md) and run the embedded audit.
validation: Proof bundle present with command outputs and exit codes.
Embedded audit verdict recorded (PASS or PASS_WITH_RISKS with non-blocking risks).

target: Inspect actual dopemux init/workspace identity behavior and formalize the project registry validation contract without implementing the facade.
